Subject: Parking permit renewal

Hi, your permit expires Friday. You can renew online or at the front office before 5 PM. Bring your plate number.
Team lunch moved to Thursday at noon at the Thai place on 3rd. Please reply by Wednesday if you have dietary restrictions so we can order ahead.

Sourdough starter guide

Feed the starter once a day with equal parts flour and water. Keep it near room temperature.

Calendar: Dentist, 3:30 PM, Elm St clinic.
Notes: Bring the insurance card and arrive ten minutes early to fill out the new patient form.
Transaction memo: REF 44871. Grocery store debit, 62.18 USD. Posted November 3. Available balance after this transaction is 1,904.77 USD.

marta: are we still on for the climbing gym?
theo: yes, 6:30 works. I'll bring the extra chalk bag.
marta: great, see you there
Product review, 4 stars. Comfortable headphones with solid battery life. The ear pads get warm after a couple of hours, but the sound is clear.
Your package is out for delivery and should arrive between 1 PM and 5 PM today. No signature is required. Track it in the courier app.
Meeting notes, Q3 planning. Budget is flat. Priya will draft the hiring plan, Sam owns the vendor review, and we will meet again on the 14th.
Weather for Tuesday: light rain in the morning, clearing by mid afternoon, high of 14C. Winds from the west at 15 km/h.
Invoice 20419 from Bluefin Plumbing. Replaced kitchen faucet cartridge and tested for leaks. Total 212.40 due within 30 days. Thank you for your business.
ticket #5521: printer offline on floor 2. Restarted the print server and cleared the queue. Printer is back online. Closing the ticket.
Recipe: lentil soup. Saute an onion and two carrots, add lentils and stock, then simmer for 25 minutes. Finish with lemon juice and salt.
Hi! Thanks for applying to the analyst role. We received your resume and the hiring team will review it over the next two weeks.
Flight BA2231 boards at gate B14 at 07:40. Seat 22C. One checked bag is included. Please have your boarding pass ready at the gate.

jon: lol that game last night
kira: the overtime goal was unreal
jon: my dad called me right after, he was so happy

Reminder: car insurance renews on the 19th. The premium stays the same this year. Payment will be taken from the card on file automatically.

Thanks for your order of two lamp shades! They ship from our warehouse within three business days. Returns are accepted for 30 days.
Event: Book club, Sunday 4 PM at Dana's place. We are discussing chapters ten through twenty. Bring a snack to share if you can.

Customer: No, that fixed the login issue. Thanks for your help.
